title: Seedan
desc: Mano is in love with Maha, a maid, in his grandmother's house, but lacks the courage to confess to his mother. After his marriage is fixed, a distraught Maha vents her anger in Lord Murugan's temple.

title: Pa. Pandi
desc: Pandian Pazhanisami, a retired man, misses his youthful days and embarks on a mission to find his first love and reconnect with her.

title: Ragasiya Kolayaali
desc: Anwar is a consulting criminologist who helps the Kerala Police occasionally. When a string of serial killings happen in quick succession, he must race against time to find the one responsible.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Jagame Thandhiram
desc: Suruli, a gangster, goes to London and becomes embroiled in several criminal activities, but the stakes rise when he falls in love with a singer named Attila.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Deja Vu
desc: An undercover police inspector investigates a mysterious abduction case of the daughter of the director general of police of a state which bears similarity with the description of a crime novelist.

title: Oosaravelli
desc: Tony, a man involved in mercenary activities, saves an abducted woman, Niharika, from a group of hooligans. Later, he falls in love with her and sets out to avenge the deaths of her family members.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Rangoon
desc: Julia journeys to the Indo-Burma border to perform for the troops during World War II, on the insistence of Billimoria, her lover. There, she finds herself enamoured by Jemadar Malik, a soldier.

title: Sweetheart!
desc: An animator struggles with commitment issues when his girlfriend reveals that she is pregnant. His emotional journey unfolds with surprising humor, leading to personal growth and self-discovery.

title: Hyper
desc: Suryanarayana Murthy is protective of his father, who is an honest government officer. However, when a politician causes trouble for his father, Surya strives to protect him.

title: IPC 376
desc: A police officer looks into an informer who can predict future murders in a mysterious way. Soon, she unearths a sinister murder mystery that leads to a shocking truth.

title: Saivam
desc: When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Dhamaka
desc: Things get complicated when Swami and Anand, two look-alike men from different backgrounds, fall in love with the same girl.
